verdict.rationale: A national company registry could plausibly publish a public data API, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only two probes, both returning HTTP 403 at robots.txt for mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in, and nothing was fetched beyond that. There is therefore no evidence of published endpoints, a key-issuance path, or stated rate limits. Confidence is low because the wall blocked inspection rather than showing the capability is absent.
